# IFireballRules.StartScale property

How big the ball is drawn when thrown, as a multiple of the game's full-grown ball: 0.1 by default. It then grows steadily to [`MaxScale`](./MaxScale.md) over [`GrowthTime`](./GrowthTime.md).

public float StartScale { get; set; }
